in_sanskrit.name: Puna
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Flood, Deluge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Puna एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Puna is derived from the Sanskrit word 'punah' meaning 'to renew, to flood'. This name is associated with freshness, renewal, and the cleansing power of water. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is known to manifest in the form of a flood to cleanse the world of impurities.
